name: Snapshot of Gammerita
summary: In the Hinterlands, Gammerita’s image is captured with Curgle’s Super Snapper FX. Daryn Lightwind in Rut’theran Village wants the snapshot for her studies.

sections.title: A Picture for Daryn
sections.body: Curgle lends the Super Snapper FX for a picture of Gammerita in the Hinterlands. Daryn Lightwind waits in Rut’theran Village to receive the snapshot and says Curgle’s invention has met her expectations.

faq.answer: Gammerita is a creature in the Hinterlands, and Daryn Lightwind asks for her picture.
Daryn Lightwind wants it for her studies; she waits in Rut’theran Village.
Curgle’s Super Snapper FX takes the snapshot when aimed at Gammerita.

faq.q: What is the Super Snapper FX?
faq.answer: The Super Snapper FX is Curgle’s invention, lent out so a picture of Gammerita can be made.
